{{Top|leg}}
A '''splitter coupling''' was a component on the [[AG-2G quad laser cannon/Legends|AG-2G quad laser cannons]]. Mounted at the end of the [[Barrel/Legends|barrel]], the weapon's [[Laser tip/Legends|laser tips]] were connected to the splitter coupling. The coupling slightly dispersed the energy beam, allowing it to land two hits simultaneously on a target's [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shield]]. This increased the chances of overloading an enemy's shields, allowing for an increased chance of the strike causing more damage.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
